messages:
maya (partnerships): Quick sync — NimbusHW asked us to onboard 'apac-southwest-2' as an edge PoP in the marketplace next sprint. They need quota entitlements and a marketplace SKU live by EOW. Who owns approvals?
tony (nimbus-hw): We can supply 8 A10 nodes at that PoP in week 2. Expect ~60k tokens/s sustained for their target shards. Need SKU + pricing band created.
samir (cloud-partners): Marketplace side needs entitlement file, billing SKU, and partner contact for onboarding form. Quota request to cloud infra: we can pre-approve up to 16 nodes, >16 needs sign-off.
vikas (infra): From infra: autoscale group + healthchecks OK. Two asks: (1) KV cache location (local PoP vs central)? (2) fallback region policy if PoP is full. Also need estimated RPS and p95 target for capacity planning.
maya (partnerships): @tony send RPS/latency. We should aim for p95 < 60ms to meet Nimbus SLA.
tony (nimbus-hw): Baseline: 3k rps, 55ms p95 with quantized 8-bit model. Spike: 7k rps sustained during marketing windows. We'll provide formal perf matrix later today.
leah (legal): Marketplace listing requires updated partner addendum + MSA signature. Are we reusing existing MSA or new SOW? New SOW adds ~2 weeks procurement.
maya (partnerships): Try to reuse existing MSA (signed 2024). Tony, confirm they accept same terms.
tony (nimbus-hw): They accept current MSA but want short SOW for region-specific pricing. We'll draft SOW tonight.
samir (cloud-partners): I'll submit soft quota request for 12 nodes (ticket ID will be posted). Need justification string — Maya paste product rationale?
maya (partnerships): Rationale: "NimbusHW wants APAC SouthWest PoP to reduce inference latency for APAC customers and join marketplace promo. Initial committed demand = 3k rps; burst = 7k rps."
vikas (infra): Also need average sequence length and KV cache hit rate estimate — affects memory.
tony (nimbus-hw): Avg seq len 128 tokens, KV hitrate ~18% initially.
leah (legal): I'll prep addendum template for region SOWs. ETA tomorrow EOD.
samir (cloud-partners): Submitted quota ticket: #Q-2029-APACSW2. They asked for escalation contacts. Who should I list?
maya (partnerships): List: maya@redwood.com, samir@redwood.com, tony@nimbushw.com.
deploy-bot: Marketplace deploy checklist created: checklist/1858123456-apacsw2. Items: SKU mapping, entitlement file, legal addendum, quota approval, billing test.
vikas (infra): Ops item: add canary policy — route 10% traffic to new PoP for first 48h. Auto-fallback to apac-north-1?
maya (partnerships): Yes. Canary + auto-fallback to apac-north-1. I'll note that in rollout plan.
tony (nimbus-hw): We'll sign SOW and send perf matrix by 1800 PT. Target SKU publish Friday if legal + quota green.
samir (cloud-partners): If legal addendum & quota approved, yes; otherwise move to Monday.
leah (legal): I can fast-track addendum if partnerships flags priority. Ping me if procurement blocked.
maya (partnerships): Action list: (1) Tony: SOW + perf matrix (today). (2) Samir: track quota #Q-2029-APACSW2. (3) Vikas: prepare canary + fallback config. (4) Leah: addendum draft. (5) Maya: assemble SKU payload and publish checklist.
maya (partnerships): tagging exec channel for visibility: @ceo FYI (not announcing yet) :eyes: 
tony (nimbus-hw): Thanks all — will update after SOW.
samir (cloud-partners): Noted. I'll update ticket with ETA once quota team responds.
vikas (infra): I'll open infra PR for canary config this afternoon.
leah (legal): Draft in Drive: /legal/partner-addendums/nimbus-apac-sw2.
maya (partnerships): Great progress. DM me if blockers. :thumbsup:
